item.title: Settlement Reached in Wrongful Death Suit Against San Angelo Nursing Home
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A wrongful death lawsuit against a San Angelo nursing home alleging negligence in the care of a 75-year-old resident who developed severe pressure ulcers after a COVID-19 hospitalization has reached a settlement agreement, court records show. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 1 Wall, No. 2 Coahoma Set for Epic Clash in Regional Final
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The No. 1-ranked Wall Lady Hawks are on the doorstep of their first trip to the state semifinals since 2019.Standing in their way is a No. 2-ranked Coahoma team that has won 30 games in a row. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State Tennis to Put Unbeaten Record to the Test on the Road
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Angelo State’s women’s tennis team will travel to Oklahoma this weekend for matches against Arkansas Tech and Southeastern Oklahoma as the Rambelles look to extend their undefeated start to the season.Angelo State, 7-0, faces Arkansas Tech at noon Friday in Edmond, Oklahoma, before taking on Southeastern Oklahoma at 11 a.m. Saturday in Durant, Oklahoma. Learn More Here.

item.title: Wall Softball Debuts at No. 13 in First State Rankings
item.description: WALL, TX — The Wall Lady Hawks debuted at No. 13 in Class 3A in the first state softball rankings of the season this week.Wall, which has a record of 12-1, has won eight straight games heading into a matchup this afternoon with Anderson-Shiro at a tournament in Llano.Wall’s only loss was against Smithson Valley, which is ranked No. 12 in Class 5A. Learn More Here.

item.title: Brews, Ewes & BBQ Returns with a Stacked Stage, Sizzling Cook-Off, and Family Fun
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX - Mark your calendars for March 7, 2026 because Brews, Ewes & BBQ is bringing the smoke, the sound, and the spirit back to Downtown San Angelo. From live music and craft brews to a high-energy BBQ Cook-Off, Kids’ Que, and a bustling vendor fair, this full-day celebration promises something for everyone. Learn More Here.

item.title: UPDATE: Anson, Clyde City Managers Each Arrested in Last 10 Days
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The city managers of two Abilene-area towns have each been arrested in the last 10 days.The city manager of Anson, Ervin “Sonny” Campbell, was booked into the Taylor County Jail in Abilene on Wednesday. Learn More Here.

item.title: San Angelo Assistant Chief Graduates from Prestigious Texas Leadership Command College
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX - The San Angelo Police Department announced that Assistant Chief Craig Thomason has successfully graduated from the Leadership Command College, Class 103, a prestigious executive-level training program for law enforcement leaders across Texas.The Leadership Command College is an intensive, multi-module program designed to strengthen executive leadership, strategic thinking, and organizational management within law enforcement agencies. Learn More Here.

item.title: Justin Jonas Named San Angelo Chamber of Commerce Man of the Year for 2026
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The San Angelo Chamber of Commerce has selected Justin Jonas as its 2026 Man of the Year, the highest honor bestowed upon an individual whose leadership, character, and contributions have profoundly shaped the city’s future.A lifelong champion of agriculture, entrepreneurship, and community service, Jonas was honored Thursday night during the Chamber’s annual awards ceremony.
